# Service-Contract Quality Checklist: Domain Service Layer for Backend Integration

**Purpose**: Validate that the spec's requirements for typed service inputs/outputs, the uniform
response envelope, and per-package operation coverage are complete, unambiguous, and consistent —
a pre-plan self-review by the spec author.
**Created**: 2026-07-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context
and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are requirements defined for every backend operation group represented in the API
      contract (auth, account, games, friends, notifications, reports, report types, trust score,
      admin, and every Caro sub-area), so no operation is left uncovered by a functional
      requirement? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK002 Are output-type requirements for list/paginated endpoints (friends, notifications,
      match lobby, tournaments) specific enough to cover the pagination metadata shape itself, not
      just "a typed list"? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK003 Is a requirement defined for what a service function returns when a resource
      legitimately no longer exists (e.g., a deleted match, a cancelled tournament) as distinct
      from a genuine server error? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for how a caller distinguishes "no data yet" (e.g., zero
      notifications) from a failure result? [Gap, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK005 Is there a requirement covering whether any client-side input validation happens in
      the service layer itself, or whether validation is entirely deferred to the backend's
      response? [Gap]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is "one consistent, typed shape" (FR-001) precise enough to determine whether success
      and failure share a single type or are a discriminated union of two distinct types? [Clarity,
      Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "typed per the corresponding backend contract" (FR-007, FR-008) specific enough to
      determine the required source of truth for those types? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "a limited number of times with backoff" (FR-024) quantified with an actual retry
      count and backoff strategy, or left open-ended? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "held only in memory" (FR-023) specific enough to rule out indirect persistence
      (e.g., state hydrated into a cache or storage layer by a framework) that could unintentionally
      leak the access token? [Clarity, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK010 Are the five failure categories in FR-005 (auth required, authorization denied,
      invalid input, not found, server error) defined precisely enough to map unambiguously onto
      backend responses, with no case that could plausibly fit two categories at once? [Clarity,
      Spec §FR-005]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Do the per-package requirements (FR-007–FR-022) hold a consistent level of detail, or
      do some packages receive materially more/less specification than others? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the response-envelope requirement (FR-001; Key Entities: Standard Response
      Envelope) consistent with the Assumptions claim that it "mirrors the backend's existing
      response envelope" — i.e., is it clear what the envelope looks like for a failure that never
      reaches the backend (e.g., a network error with no backend envelope to mirror)? [Consistency,
      Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK013 Are pagination requirements stated with equal specificity across every list-returning
      operation across packages (profiles' friends/notifications, admin's reports, game-caro's
      lobby/tournaments), rather than implied only for some? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK014 Can SC-001 ("100% of the operations... available as a typed service function") be
      verified against a fixed, enumerable list, or does "operations that a webapp screen needs"
      leave the denominator subjective? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK015 Can SC-003 ("zero call sites needing domain-specific or endpoint-specific error-shape
      handling") be verified at the requirements level, without depending on implementation
      choices not yet made? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK016 Is SC-005 ("caught before the code runs") specific enough to constitute a testable
      pass/fail criterion on its own? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK017 Do the primary-path acceptance scenarios (User Stories 1–5) have equivalent coverage
      depth across all five packages, or are some packages thinner than others? [Coverage]
- [ ] CHK018 Are package-specific exception flows called out anywhere beyond the cross-cutting
      FR-005 taxonomy — e.g., a game-caro rule violation such as submitting a move out of turn?
      [Gap, Coverage]
- [ ] CHK019 Is a recovery expectation defined for a session-refresh failure that occurs mid-action
      (e.g., the user was submitting a Caro move when the refresh failed) — is the in-flight action
      lost, retried, or explicitly undefined? [Gap, Recovery Flow]
- [ ] CHK020 Are non-functional requirements beyond the clarified security/reliability items (e.g.,
      a per-call timeout budget) defined, or explicitly deferred to planning? [Gap, Non-Functional]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK021 Is behavior specified for a service call made while a session refresh is already in
      flight (concurrent calls racing on the same token refresh)? [Gap, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK022 Is behavior specified for the case where a mutating call succeeds on the backend but
      the client never receives the response, leaving success/failure ambiguous to the caller?
      [Gap, Edge Case]
- [x] CHK023 Does FR-024's "idempotent calls" qualifier have a defined boundary — i.e., does the
      spec state which operations are considered idempotent (safe to auto-retry) versus which
      mutating gameplay/chat actions must not be silently retried? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-024]
      — Resolved 2026-07-02: FR-024 now explicitly restricts auto-retry to safe `GET` requests;
      mutating requests are explicitly excluded, with a matching Edge Cases bullet and
      Clarifications entry.

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK024 Is the assumption that "the backend already standardizes on this pattern" (uniform
      envelope) traceable to the actual API contract, or stated as an unverified assumption? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the dependency on the backend contract file (`04-Projects/api/openapi.yml`)
      remaining stable during development documented, including what happens if the contract
      changes mid-implementation? [Dependency, Gap]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK026 Does the spec establish that cross-package references to an account (e.g., the target
      of a friend request or a report) are typed consistently with the Account entity, rather than
      leaving each FR free to define its own ad-hoc reference shape? [Ambiguity]
- [ ] CHK027 Is there a requirement/acceptance-criteria ID cross-reference (FR-### ↔ SC-### ↔ User
      Story) so a reviewer can trace which success criterion each functional requirement supports?
      [Traceability, Gap]

## Notes

- Check items off as completed: `[x]`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
